title: Configurable range views
body:
It would be really great if you could add a setting to configure how many time in past we see the BG curve.
Same way as NS doest it for example with a 3, 6, 12 and 24 hours views.

Would it be possible?

comments.body:
Some of this is dynamically scaled, for example as soon as a treatment simulation is in effect but otherwise it might be possible. 

I certainly could do it by optionally replacing the bottom zoom chart with buttons to select the time period. Would that work for you?
I think this is a really good idea and would love to see it!
IF you long press on the xDrip icon on the app home screen you can enable time buttons. If you long press on a time button you can lock the view to that time period.
